messages:
alex: FYI SummitCorp POC is blocked — they can’t finish SSO/identity provisioning. Customer says provisioning API times out and Okta SCIM test fails. Need quick unblock before EOW or we lose exec slot. :grimacing:
maria: Ugh. Do we have the specific error? Summit sent a screenshot?
kevin: I created a support ticket with the on-call infra team, ticket #SUM-12345. deploy-bot created it: ticket SUM-12345 (priority: high).
deploy-bot: New support ticket SUM-12345 created by kevin. Assigned to eng-infra oncall.
alex: Screenshot says: "SCIM test: 504 gateway timeout" when hitting /v1/provisioning/okta. They’re using our hosted API endpoint in us-west-2.
maria: Possible causes: IP allowlist, mutual TLS, or our reverse-proxy config for long-running SCIM syncs. Also need to confirm they used the right bearer token (scoped).
jiya: I can take a look at logs. @maria can you paste the exact curl they ran? Also we need the Okta org ID and the provisioning user in their tenant.
maria: Pasted from customer: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/provisioning/okta/sync" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"okta_org_id":"00u1abcd2EFGH3","start_full_sync":true}'
```
jiya: Thanks. That token looks like a user token, not a service token. If they used a per-user token without the provisioning scope, the proxy could reject. Also seeing spikes from their IP range in the logs — rate-limited then 504.
kevin: They said they tried twice and then our portal blocked further attempts. Do we have a temporary bypass we can enable for the POC?
jiya: I can whitelist their IP range for 24h and add a provisional rule allowing POST /v1/provisioning/* for token scope check bypass (audit-only) so they can finish setup. Need sign-off from legal for scope bypass?
pat: For short-lived dev/testing bypass, legal is OK with audit-only exceptions if we log and notify. I'll add the exception to the ticket. Keep it 24h and we need their signed AUP (we already have SOW).
maria: Thanks @jiya @pat. While infra does whitelist, we should also confirm SAML metadata vs SCIM; Summit prefers SAML for SSO but needs SCIM for provisioning. If SCIM isn't viable, we can accept manual CSV upload for POC as fallback.
alex: Customer also asked about Dedicated pricing delta for the POC if we need a private connector — they want an estimate. They expect a number by tomorrow's call.
kevin: Quick calc: dedicated dev pool (2x A10G equiv) add-on ~ $18k/mo (list). For a short-term POC we can offer discounted trial $3k for 30 days. Need pricing ops confirmation.
aj: (not in channel)
jija: typo — ignore
pat: Pricing ops needs a one-liner justification. If we position as "trial discount to validate integration" legal and finance are fine. I'll draft language.
maria: Ok infra says they pushed a temporary rule. Can someone trigger a new SCIM test? @alex please ask Summit to re-run the curl but use the token we provided via secure channel.
alex: Pinged Summit: re-run now, will update in 5.
kevin: Also heads-up: customer security team will complete our vendor questionnaire but flagged data residency and KMS. Summit requires explicit mention we support BYO-KMS on Private deployments. They want to see a yes/no in the questionnaire.
jiya: We support BYO-KMS in Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC). For Hosted we offer customer-managed keys via partner KMS integrations in limited regions; I'll fill that in and attach our SOC2 section.
alex: Summit re-ran test — "200 OK" on provisioning endpoint and user created. They confirmed SCIM synced 1k users. :tada:
maria: Nice. Can we close ticket? Make sure to revert whitelist at 24h.
jiya: Will revert at 24h and post logs to SUM-12345. Also added a comment about long-term: use service token with provisioning scope and use retry/backoff on their side.
alex: Customer asked about the pricing note — can we lock in the $3k trial and send an approval note? I need a short email for the execs.
pat: Draft for execs: "Redwood will enable a 30-day POC dedicated connector (2x A10G equivalent) at a trial rate of $3,000. This includes 24/7 support for onboarding, and required temporary infra exceptions (24h whitelist) to validate SCIM. Standard licensing applies after trial; procurement to execute SOW amendment." Use that?
\ekevin: Works for me.
alex: Sending draft to Summit execs now.
kevin: Closing checklist: - SUM-12345 ticket updated - whitelist to be removed in 24h - legal/finance note attached - pricing email sent
maria: All done from my side.
jiya: Whitelist removal scheduled.
deploy-bot: Support ticket SUM-12345 status: RESOLVED (whitelist removed).
alex: Great job team — saved the exec slot. Closing thread. :heart:
